# Galehaven Sailing Co-op - chandlery orders

Purchase lists for the chandlery live in purchasing/, one file per
order day named YYYY-MM-DD.txt, one line per item:

    - <item> x<qty>

Rows in the quartermaster's day sheet count for the order only when
their status is order; rows marked quote only are price checks and
stay off the list. The orders/ folder holds received invoices, not
order lists - the steward's shorthand about the orders folder
refers to the chandlery paperwork, which lives in purchasing/.
